rows.text: splits `ecx` by signed division into a byte index `ecx` / 8 and a bit number `ecx` mod 8, tests that bit of the byte at `0209A2A0` plus the index, and returns 1 when it is set, else 0

addresses the 0x40-byte entry indexed by the low byte of `ecx` in the array at qword `02B47790`; only when that entry's dword `+4` equals the full `ecx`, replaces bit 7 of its byte `+1` with bit 0 of `dl`, leaving the other bits; otherwise does nothing

notes: 0025C130: the remainder is computed with the cdq/and 7 rounding, so a negative ecx gives a negative remainder; the sentence says signed division and does not describe the negative case further.
